text:
Ananya (People Ops): Starting the People Ops live thread for the all-hands Q&A — drop any questions about reviews, leveling, promotions, comp, benefits here and we'll respond in-line. I'll collect and follow up with notes + office hours.
Liam (SWE): quick q — when do mid-year reviews kick off? last year's cadence was a bit fuzzy.
Ananya (People Ops): Good call. Mid-year reviews open next Monday. TL;DR: self-review 1 week, manager review 1 week, calibration the week after. Official timeline doc: https://redwood-inference.internal/hr/review-cycle-2024 (see schedule).
Eve (Eng Manager): For calibration, are we using the same rubric as last year or an updated leveling guide? Trying to prep M1s.
Priya (People Ops): We're using the updated leveling guide v2.1 — highlights: clearer IC->Senior expectations, explicit impact examples, and updated competency language. Link in thread: https://redwood-inference.internal/hr/leveling-v2.1.pdf :point_up:
Liam (SWE): Is there guidance for managers on writing promotion packets? Last time some packets were light on impact metrics.
Ananya (People Ops): Yes — managers should include 3 concrete impact examples, associated metrics if available, feedback snippets, and a proposed new band/level. We provided a template in the leveling doc. Also sample packets in the promotion-examples folder.
Eve (Eng Manager): Great — will share with my leads. Is there a hard rule on minimum time-in-role before promotion consideration?
Priya (People Ops): No strict minimum across the board; typical expectation is ~12-18 months in role for IC promotions but exceptions are made for accelerated impact. Manager justification required for exceptions.
Liam (SWE): How are comp changes tied to promotion? Does promotion automatically come with X% base increase?
Chris (CEO): Short answer: promotions come with a market-aligned comp adjustment, not a fixed percent. We aim to make offers competitive and equitable. Priya/Ananya will share the comp adjustment bands we use as guidance.
Priya (People Ops): We have a promo adjustment guideline table (ranges by band). It's not public-facing but managers get access via the compensation playbook. We'll run a Q&A on the playbook next Wednesday at 4pm PT.
Liam (SWE): If someone feels their rating was unfair after calibration, what's the appeal path?
Ananya (People Ops): Appeal process: 1) discuss with manager within 5 business days; 2) if unresolved, escalate to People Ops for review; 3) final review panel (People Ops + cross-functional leadership). We aim for resolution within 3 weeks.
Eve (Eng Manager): Any changes to bonus timing or equity refresh cadence this cycle?
Priya (People Ops): No changes to annual bonus timing this year. Equity refresh philosophy is the same but we will prioritize high-performers and mission-critical roles. If you're budgeting for hires/promos, assume current refresh policy remains.
Liam (SWE): Benefits Q: open enrollment window dates? any new options?
Ananya (People Ops): Open enrollment is Oct 1–15. New offerings: enhanced mental health stipend and expanded parental leave global policy (docs will be in Benefits folder).
HR Bot: New doc uploaded: /hr/review-cycle-2024 — people-ops updated the timeline (uploaded by Priya).
Eve (Eng Manager): Will there be calibration training for new managers? I have one manager who hasn't done them before.
Priya (People Ops): Yes — mandatory 90-min calibration training next Friday (recording will be available). RSVP link: https://calendar.redwood-inference/internal/calibration-training
Liam (SWE): Are comp bands changing with the Series C budget? worried about freezes.
Chris (CEO): No comp freeze. We are being deliberate with spend but committed to competitive compensation. Any headcount/budgetary constraints should come from hiring committees not a blanket freeze.
Ananya (People Ops): Thanks all for the great questions. We'll compile a short FAQ from this thread and follow up with meeting notes and the promo template. Office hours scheduled: Thursday 2–4pm PT in #people-ops-office-hours. If you prefer a private chat, DM Priya or me. :sparkles:
